name: activity-tree-intent-geometry
description: A 200-character intent cannot starve a short delegate name or hide its own Open control. Real phone Sheet insets at the issue's 320/360/390/430px viewports through eight nested groups, plus a wide 900px row whose full name and 60% meta cap must be untouched by the name floor.

mutation.note: Chrome exited 1 on the restored pre-floor baseline of this same case: 320px/depth 1 dropped the name to 5.03px, 320px/depth 0 to 5.70px, 360px/depth 3 to 5.11px, 390px/depth 8 to 2.81px and 430px/depth 8 to 4.23px - all under the guard's 16px readable floor. The 430px root and the 900px row kept their full names (45.23px) in both runs, which is the comfortable-width half of the contract. Stylesheet restored byte-for-byte before the passing run.

previous.note: Chrome exited 1: all nine names fell below 16px (6.84-9.61px) and every meta exceeded 60% of row content width. The 430px root also lost its full name. Stylesheet restored byte-for-byte before the passing runs.
